This is a sample text lesson! Text lessons let you use formatted text, so you can use written lessons
as part of your course, but they also support adding images and embeds.
Along with file uploads, this lesson type will be the most common one you use in your courses.
For example:
• This is a bullet point
• This is a bolded bullet
• This bullet is bolded and italicized
• This text is larger than normal
• This text is smaller than normal
You can type "/" to format text and add images or embeds.
For example, here's an image of one of the worksheets in Podia's course "Get Noticed!" (which you
get free access to as part of your Podia plan).
